duration.text: The Architecture at University of Science and Technology Liaoning is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Passport sized photo*2. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity).*3. Valid non-criminal record report (within 6 months)*4. English proficiency test certificate*5. Notarized previous school diploma or degree certificateAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*6. Notarized official transcriptsAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: academic transcript in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*7. Bank Statement (enough to cover your expenses)*8. A photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form(within 6 months)*9. Passport blank page*10. Statement of guarantor

requirements.text: Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports, be in good health with good conduct, and abide by laws and regulations of the Chinese government as well as rules and regulations of the school.Applicants who apply for a bachelor's degree shall have a high school education or above, and generally no more than 35 years old.Applicants' academic achievement and language ability shall satisfy the entrance requirements of the applied majors, a 4-point IELTS score (or equivalent level) in English Lectures.
